create_dataset_wrapper: create a DatasetWithEnumeratedTargets wrapper that adds index-based targets to an existing PyTorch dataset
use_getitem: use the __getitem__ method to retrieve an image and its enumerated target tuple by index
use_get_target: use get_target to fetch the enumerated target tuple containing the index and original target
use_get_image_data: use get_image_data to retrieve raw image bytes for a given dataset index
use_len: use __len__ to get the total number of samples in the wrapped dataset
